backtest_story: ARGOS has a strong informational walk-forward validation layer and separately executed fixed economic event-trading rules with PIT entry/exit, matched SPY benchmark, explicit costs, equal-notional sizing, multiplicity control and promotion gates. The economic rules failed promotion; later H2 also failed, so no long/short rule is promoted and C0_NO_TRADE remains the defensible capital decision.
limitation: The economic experiments were event/opportunity based. A standard financed portfolio path with explicit treatment of overlapping positions was not part of the authoritative frozen protocol, so the report should not invent Sharpe or portfolio drawdown after the fact.
